## Packages

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
```


## Load Data

```{r}
SoTL_courses <- readRDS("data/combined_courses_20250529.rds")
```

## Explore Data

### Filtered Terms

```{r}
# Terms to keep
keep_terms <- c(
  "Fall 2022",
  "Spring 2023",
  "Summer 2023",
  "Fall 2023",
  "Spring 2024",
  "Summer 2024",
  "Fall 2024",
  "Spring 2025"
)

SoTL_courses_filtered <- SoTL_courses %>%
  filter(term %in% keep_terms)

```


### Remove Duplicates

The dataset is a comprehensive collection of student enrollment records that captures detailed information about students' participation in courses over multiple academic terms. Each row represents an individual student's enrollment in a particular course section during a specific term. This means that if a student enrolls in multiple courses, sections, or terms, they will appear multiple times in the dataset—once for each enrollment event. It's important to note that the dataset focuses on distinct enrollments rather than individual students. Therefore, repeating a course is not considered a duplication; it's treated as a separate enrollment event. However, the dataset contains duplicates of these distinct enrollments due to students having **multiple majors and plans**. Additionally, some courses will have **more than one instructor**. These duplicates arise because the same enrollment event is recorded multiple times—once for each major or plan and instructor associated with the student. 



```{r}
nrow(SoTL_courses_filtered)
```


```{r}
SoTL_courses <- SoTL_courses_filtered %>%
  distinct(i_dsubstitute, term_source_key, course_id, instructor_full_name, section, .keep_all = TRUE)
```


```{r}
nrow(SoTL_courses)
```




### Unique instructors and courses

We investigate the names of all the unique instructors and courses in the dataset.

```{r}
instructor_courses_collapsed <- SoTL_courses %>%
  group_by(instructor_full_name) %>%
  summarise(
    courses = paste(sort(unique(course)), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

instructor_courses_collapsed

```

```{r}
instructor_courses_collapsed <- SoTL_courses %>%
  group_by(instructor_full_name, course_owner_dept) %>%
  summarise(
    courses = paste(sort(unique(course)), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
instructor_courses_collapsed
```


```{r}
course_instructors_collapsed <- SoTL_courses %>%
  group_by(course, course_owner_dept) %>%
  summarise(
    instructors   = paste(sort(unique(instructor_full_name)), collapse = ", "),
    n_instructors = n_distinct(instructor_full_name),
    .groups       = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(course_owner_dept, course)

course_instructors_collapsed
```
